title: Ephesus
lead: The leading city of the Roman province of Asia, a port with the great temple of Artemis. Paul spent over two years there (Acts 19), later wrote to Timothy there (1 Timothy 1:3), and the letter to the Ephesians bears its name (Ephesians 1:1, though the oldest manuscripts lack "in Ephesus"). The first of Revelation's seven letters is to its church (Revelation 2:1–7).
